module_architecture: Shashlik calorimeter: alternating tungsten + LYSO:Ce tile layers (FIXED all campaign), sampled at shower max by an interchangeable 2x2 capillary set (14x14 mm face) = the light-collection channel. Campaigns differ ONLY in the capillary set: LuAG:Ce fibers (runs 12-30), DSB:Ce glass (31-38), EJ-199 WLS (39-44). Both XCET threshold Cherenkovs are beamline elements UPSTREAM of the module.
